correctness.rationale: Higashine's exhaustive ambient classification, including the family with parameter in the algebraic closure, gives precisely the indicated in-plane lines and all other lines meeting the plane only at N. Each [t:1:0] forces L_t. For d nonzero, the characteristic-two linear map t -> t^2+dt has kernel {0,d}, so each of Q/2 points of row d outside its image forces M_d; row zero is covered by bijective squaring and N by the selected pencil. This proves minimum and uniqueness even for ambient lines. Pair intersections [tu:t+u:1] have exactly two L-branches (the two roots of a separable quadratic) and one M-branch, and every mixed intersection is of this form. The only pencil crossing is N, which is modular because each other crossing is on a selected pencil line. For a characteristic-independent freeness check, let P be the pencil product and F the product of the Q lines L_t. Fix a derivation with Y and W components both P/(Y+W), logarithmic along the pencil. To extend it along all L_t, prescribe its X component on each L_t as -(t+t^2)P/(Y+W). These prescriptions agree on L_t intersect L_u by tangency to M_(t+u). Inductively on a new L_t the discrepancy is divisible by the product of the restricted old linear forms because they are distinct there up to nonzero scalars (the parameters t+u are distinct). Lift the quotient and correct the X component by a multiple of the product of the old L_u, preserving homogeneity of degree Q-2. This gives a logarithmic derivation which, with Euler and F times partial_X, has coefficient determinant equal to a unit times FP. Divisibility of the analogous Cramer determinants by all distinct line forms gives a basis over K without a characteristic-zero assumption. Over a field of size E=Q^r, subtracting exactly 2 per triple and Q-2 at N from (2Q-1)(E+1) gives the claimed complement (E-Q)(E-Q+2); expanding this quadratic in the exponential zeta definition yields each stated factor. Independent row arithmetic gives profiles (152,120,1) and (2144,2016,1) at Q=16,64, with respective multiplicities (1,3,Q-1). evidence: The dual is the conic ac=b^2 with its point at infinity omitted, together with its tangent a=0 minus that conic point and the nucleus; it is the symmetric difference of the conic hyperoval with that tangent.
